_comment: Cards that exist only for the airbend test (tests/unit/test_airbend.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_gale_reversal` is airbend's one line on a free sorcery, so a board can be set without spending the mana the {2} assertions then count. `t_gale_scatter` is the same sorcery written with plain `exile` + `playable` -- the near miss the gap record named -- and it is what measures both halves: it grants to the caster rather than each owner, and it charges the printed price. `t_stone_yak` costs a single GREEN pip, so a seat holding only Plains can pay {2} and could never pay {G}; `t_thunder_drake` costs {4}{U}{U}, six mana of which two are pips no reduction can reach, so {2} off two lands is a replacement and not a discount at any amount.

cards.name: Test Gale Reversal
cards.oracle_text: Airbend all creatures. (Exile them. While each one is exiled, its owner may cast it for {2} rather than its mana cost.)

cards.name: Test Gale Scatter
cards.oracle_text: Exile all creatures. While each one is exiled, you may cast it.
